input.summary: Ported to SYCL 2020 with no dpct helpers. It compiles cleanly without the dpct include path. I did not run it or compare its output against the reference, so correctness is untested. Both kernels use 1-D nd_range. softMax2 uses one sub-group per slice with sycl::reduce_over_group, and it has no hard-coded sub-group size of 32. The grid is sized from the device's smallest supported sub-group size, so it covers every slice whatever sub-group size the compiler picks. I replaced sycl::native::exp (from the migration) with sycl::exp to stay within the 1e-6 tolerance.
